page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m4.large is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 family, utilizing the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration provides 2 vCPUs mapped to 2 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core, alongside 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance features a shared CPU allocation model, meaning compute resources are shared with other tenants. It does not include any local storage or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The baseline network bandwidth is specified at 0 Gbps, and there are no dedicated GPU accelerators present on this hardware profile.

Given the shared CPU allocation and 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, this instance is structured for budget-conscious, low-intensity workloads. It is suitable for basic web serving, development environments, and lightweight background tasks that do not require sustained, dedicated compute performance or local storage.
